changelog:
ai-qa-agent v1.0.0

- Initial release of the AI QA Agent skill.
- Provides structured, multi-track reviews for code correctness, data integrity, brand voice compliance, and document formatting.
- Includes detailed checklists and scoring rubrics for clear, actionable QA reports.
- Designed as the final quality assurance step for any deliverable before delivery or sign-off.
- Not intended for initial content creation, complex bug fixing, or deployment validation.
summary: AI QA Agent — the final quality gate before delivery. Tests code for correctness, verifies data integrity, checks brand voice compliance, and reviews document formatting. Use this skill whenever the user needs to review, verify, check, audit, inspect, or validate any deliverable before it ships. Tri
